evidence: Plaut. Mil. 642: vel cavillātor facētus vel convīva commodus
Cic. Off. 1.108: dulcem et facētum fēstīvīque sermōnis … Sōcratem accēpimus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Its noun is facētiae, wit; its adverb facētē.

terms.gloss: witty, with a sharp tang (literally salted)
evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.228: esse quamvīs facētum atque salsum (Lewis & Short)
Quint. 6.3.18: salsum in cōnsuētūdine prō rīdiculō tantum accēpimus (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: vel cavillātor facētus vel convīva commodus item erō
phrases.english: I can be a witty banterer just as well as an agreeable guest

sources: Lewis & Short: facetus · Lewis & Short: salio
